664:t_1:6.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Now then, let us begin... The feast of vengeance, in this closed universe.」

664:t_1:7.en:
???
(I knew it... You really won't forgive us...)

664:t_2:3.en:
$$ランカ$$
「...Thank goodness. The fleet is safe, too.」

664:t_2:4.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「$$ランカ$$... There's no telling what will happen from here on. You go to Island 1 too, like $$シェリル$$.」

664:t_2:5.en:
$$ランカ$$
「But if I have this little one with me, some people will probably be scared...」

664:t_2:7.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「A $$バジュラ$$ larva separated from its swarm...」

664:t_2:8.en:
$$ランカ$$
「The $$バジュラ$$ came to understand us... So I want to protect this little one.」

664:t_2:9.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「...All right. For now, stay on the $$クォーター$$ until things settle down.」

664:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$ブレラ$$, who sees his past self in the controlled $$バジュラ$$... $$レド$$ and $$チェインバー#pilot$$, who feel themselves growing through their fight with $$ストライカー#pilot$$...」

664:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In battles with the galaxy as their stage, each one's feelings give birth to $$Ｚチップ$$...」

664:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The 100 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$ born that way will surely become the power that saves us.」

664:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not that I should be saying such things at a time like this, but the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ is open for business!」

664:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The celebration for our ace pilots will have to wait for another occasion, but I'll give it my all again today... business, business!」

664:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not that I should be saying such things at a time like this, but for now we're open for business!」

664:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The celebration for our ace pilots will have to wait for another occasion, but I'll give it my all again today... business, business!」

665:t_000:1.en:
$$ボビー$$
「Looks like we got back to normal space, but...」

665:t_000:2.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Judging by the surroundings, I believe this is the galactic center region.」

665:t_000:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's right. This location is about 1,000 light-years from the galactic center.」

665:t_000:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Also, all ships other than the $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ are confirmed safe within a 2,000 km radius.」

665:t_000:5.en:
$$モニカ$$
「The $$フロンティア船団$$ is safe as well.」

665:t_000:6.en:
$$トライア$$
「Well, that's a relief for now.」

665:t_000:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes. At this distance, regrouping will be quick, and...」

665:t_000:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「We should also be able to reach the galactic center in a few hyperspace jumps.」

665:t_001:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The problem is the attacks from the $$御使い$$s.」

665:t_001:1.en:
$$桂$$
「I never thought they'd come at us in hyperspace.」

665:t_001:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「With their supernatural power, a feat like that must be effortless for them.」

665:t_001:6.en:
$n
「A lot has happened and I still haven't sorted it all out, but this has made the situation simple.」

665:t_001:7.en:
$n
「The enemy we have to defeat is called the $$御使い$$s... And $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ was one of them, too... That's all there is to it.」

665:t_001:8.en:
$n
(Dad, Sis... and Mom... I'll do it, even if it costs me my life...)

665:t_001:10.en:
$$アルト$$
「No matter how mighty the $$御使い$$s' power is, Earth is protected by $$スヴェル$$. All that's left is for us to take them down.」

665:t_001:11.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But we know far too little about the $$御使い$$s.」

665:t_001:12.en:
$$タケル$$
「Higher-dimensional life forms... The superiors of the $$サイデリアル$$ who manage humanity's evolution... Beings with the power to destroy even galaxies using $$次元力$$...」

665:t_001:13.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Judging by what $$ハーデス$$, $$ズール$$ and the others said, they're hostile even to those who call themselves gods, and they seem to wield power that surpasses even theirs.」

665:t_001:14.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Thanks to the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$, we found out the $$宇宙怪獣$$' nest is at the galactic center, but we still don't even know where those guys are...」

665:t_001:15.en:
$$シモン$$
「But they know our every move. If this keeps up, we'll just be on the receiving end of one-sided attacks.」

665:t_001:16.en:
$$セツコ$$
「And... it's not as if Earth is absolutely safe, either...」

665:t_001:17.en:
$$シン$$
「It's all right, $$セツコ$$. Earth has $$スヴェル$$, after all.」

665:t_001:18.en:
$$キラ$$
「But... if the galaxy itself were destroyed, I can't believe it would come out safe...」

665:t_001:19.en:
$$葵$$
「The galaxy destruction they put on display for us, huh...」

665:t_001:20.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I think they did that to show off their power to us...」

665:t_001:21.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Smashing a whole galaxy just for that... They're outrageous.」

665:t_001:22.en:
$$シンジ$$
「If that power gets used on the galaxy we're in...」

665:t_001:23.en:
$$赤木$$
「No matter how powerful that $$スヴェル$$ thing is, there's no defending against that, is there...」

665:t_001:24.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It's all right. For now, at least...」

665:t_001:25.en:
$$トライア$$
「If they could use that kind of power, they'd have crushed the galaxy... or at least Earth, long ago.」

665:t_001:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But they haven't actually done it... We should take that as a sign that there's some reason they can't carry out the galaxy's destruction.」

665:t_001:27.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「They said that 'the preparations are complete.' In other words, the preparations for crushing this galaxy and Earth must not be finished yet.」

665:t_001:30.en:
$$トライア$$
「No use thinking about what we can't know. For now, all we can do is head for the galactic center.」

665:t_001:31.en:
$$シャア$$
「Speaking of what we don't know, there's more.」

665:t_001:33.en:
$$シャア$$
「The existence of the $$時の牢獄$$.」

665:t_001:34.en:
$$アスラン$$
「That thing that covered the $$蒼の地球$$...」

665:t_001:35.en:
$$キラ$$
「Judging from $$ガドライト#pilot$$'s actions, too, I think whoever created it is someone above the $$サイデリアル$$... in other words, the $$御使い$$s...」

665:t_001:36.en:
$$シャア$$
「And $$ガドライト#pilot$$ said that it was built to protect Earthlings.」

665:t_001:37.en:
$$シャア$$
「Yet after subjugating the $$翠の地球$$, the $$サイデリアル$$ began their invasion of the $$蒼の地球$$ as soon as the $$時の牢獄$$ was broken.」

665:t_001:38.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「It is indeed contradictory... It was meant for the $$御使い$$s to protect Earthlings, yet it was getting in the way of their invasion of Earth.」

665:t_001:39.en:
$$シン$$
「Those guys... Do they want to protect Earthlings or rule them, which is it!?」

665:t_001:40.en:
$$シャア$$
「Unfortunately, their intent is unknown... Speculating here won't give us an answer.」

665:t_001:41.en:
$$シャア$$
「But the key to resolving this contradiction probably lies in 'sorrow'.」

665:t_001:43.en:
$$シャア$$
「That's not it. I mean the other $$御使い$$, the last one remaining.」

665:t_001:45.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The four human emotions: joy, anger, sorrow and pleasure... Since there are $$御使い$$s governing joy, anger and pleasure, there must be one for the remaining emotion, sorrow, too.」

665:t_001:46.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The $$御使い$$ who still hasn't shown itself... That must be the one who governs sorrow.」

665:t_001:47.en:
$$シャア$$
「I suspect the key to resolving the contradiction the $$御使い$$s carry lies with that one.」
